text:
Alex M.: ok handing off to @Jamie R. — I'm leaving the bridge at 21:49 UTC. TL;DR: ongoing cache eviction spike in eu-west-1 causing slowed embeddings queue and elevated tail latency for a subset of customers. Primary mitigations applied but we still have intermittent 503s to the embeddings service.

Oncall Bot: Incident INC-4723 created (sev2) — bridge https://zoom.example.com/room/INC-4723, pager sent to eng-oncall.

Alex M.: timeline + what I did so far:
- 20:18 UTC: alerts started from embeddings consumer (rate of timeouts rose ~4x).
- 20:25: Scoped to eu-west-1 cluster; eviction logs point to mempressure on cache nodes (oom_kill evictions).
- 20:32: Drained non-critical jobs from node-pool cw-cache-eu-2 and cordoned 2 nodes to prevent noisy neighbor.
- 20:40: Rolled a temporary increase to cache.size_limit from 60% -> 75% via config rollout (see runbook change id rb/2026-evict-tmp).
- 20:47: Enabled more aggressive prefix-KV caching TTL for embeddings requests (expected to reduce backend lookups).

Current status:
- embeddings queue error rate: 1.8% -> peaked 3.9% -> now 1.2% (still above baseline 0.2%).
- Customers with visible impact: AcmeAnalytics (increase in inference latency), EduMate (sporadic 503s during large batch jobs).
- Ongoing mitigation: cache size increase still rolling, autoscaler cooldown adjusted to avoid immediate re-add of memory-heavy pods.

Runbook pointers:
- Runbook: https://confluence.internal/ops/runbooks/embeddings-cache-evictions
- Playbook snippet I ran:
```bash
# temporarily increase eviction threshold
redwoodctl config set cluster eu-west-1 cache.size_limit 0.75 --source=oncall
redwoodctl rolling-restart deployment cache-service --region eu-west-1
```
- If evictions continue, fallback is to switch embeddings consumer routing to the cold-embeddings pool: `routectl set policy embeddings --pool cold-embeddings --weight 1.0`

Gaps / things for incoming shift to watch: 
- Coverage gap from 23:00-00:30 UTC: I have to step away for a personal appointment; Jamie, can you take primary from 22:00-06:00? If not, we need to find coverage for the 23:00-00:30 window.
- No SRE on-call currently has hardware rights for eu-west-1 scale-up; raise infra escalation if we need hot-add GPUs/nodes (contact matt.b@redwood).

Alerting notes:
- Pager thresholds: embeddings-5xx-rate > 1% sustained for 5m -> page. Temporarily set to 2% while we finish rollout to reduce noise (I'll leave it at 2% but note it might mask regressions).
- Prometheus query used: `sum(rate(embeddings_requests_total{status=~"5..",region="eu-west-1"}[5m])) / sum(rate(embeddings_requests_total{region="eu-west-1"}[5m]))`

Action items for incoming oncall (explicit):
1) Confirm acceptance of primary and reply here.
2) Keep the bridge open if you plan to actively triage — I'll leave it up for 30 more minutes.
3) If errors climb past 3% re-open canary to previous stable config and trigger scale-up with infra.
4) Triage customer impact: reach out to Support (Lisa) for targeted messages to AcmeAnalytics + EduMate.

Jamie R.: I can take primary starting 22:00 UTC. I'll be on bridge at 22:00 and can cover the 23:00 gap. Confirming: I'll keep alerts at their current (temporarily relaxed) thresholds until we confirm stability.

Sana K.: quick note — I can be standby until 00:00 in case scaling is needed. I don't have infra rights for hot-add but can coordinate with Matt.

Matt B.: pinged infra lead (infra-pager) in case we need extra nodes. If you need hot-add in eu-west, escalate to pagers with label `hardware` and include `INC-4723` in the subject.

Lisa P.: Support: drafted an alert message for affected customers. Sending to AcmeAnalytics now; EduMate on DM to check severity and whether they want to pause job runs. If we see improvement in 30m, I'll send a follow-up note indicating mitigation and ETA for full recovery.

Alex M.: other notes:
- I disabled a scheduled heavy batch job for AcmeAnalytics (job-id: job-20260314-433) to reduce pressure — it was likely the trigger.
- Logs to watch: `/var/log/cache-service/evictions.log` and `embeddings/consumer/error.log`

Support Bot: AcmeAnalytics notified (ticket #SUP-9812). EduMate notified via DM.

Jamie R.: taking it. I'll re-check metrics at 22:05 and post a quick summary. If anything spikes before then, ping me @jamie.r in this thread or on the bridge.

Alex M.: thanks — leaving now. Bridge and notes are up to date in the runbook. Leaving handoff: Alex -> Jamie; secondary: Sana. 

Jamie R.: acknowledged. I'm primary, Sana secondary. I'll post an update at 22:05 and again at 23:15 or earlier if anything changes. :thumbsup:
